2. 3. 12. 5. 

17. Dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati. Katamehi dvīhi: ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā avaṇṇārahassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. Ananuvicca apariyogāhetvā vaṇṇārahassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. Imehi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati.110
